# Hillary Esposito

> Healthcare Product Designer and freelance UX designer based in New York. She designs clinical workflows, internal tools and research-led product decisions, and is open to full-time roles and freelance work.

Background: six years in cancer-care operations at Memorial Sloan Kettering and 13+ years of Army service, including medical logistics. Master of Healthcare Administration; Lean Six Sigma Green Belt; bilingual English and Spanish.

Contact: espositohillary@gmail.com

## Case studies

- [Service design project for Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center](https://www.hillaryesposito.com/case-study/msk/): she proposed a digital filing workflow that replaced a four-department paper detour; IT and UX built it after she changed roles.
- [Product design and research for FloraGrove, a pre-launch plant-care app](https://www.hillaryesposito.com/case-study/grove/): a plant-care prototype scoped with 5 moderated sessions and a 37-person self-report survey.
- [2.5-week design sprint with an edtech startup, run by Yummy Labs](https://www.hillaryesposito.com/case-study/knowunity/): a voice active-recall prototype; recall is mocked.
- [Service design for U.S. Army medical supply, cutting resupply from months to weeks](https://www.hillaryesposito.com/case-study/logistics/): a warehouse relocation serving seven aid stations; figures are from her Officer Evaluation Report.
- [Healthcare research based on changing Medicaid requirements](https://www.hillaryesposito.com/case-study/ux-woman/): six interviews with clinic and insurer staff, two hypotheses about one public New York Medicaid letter, and a guide built from it; untested, no patient interviews.
